title: Service index prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: Shanghai Lingshuzhonghe Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: The problem is to ensure accuracy while improving the training efficiency of a linear model in longitudinal federated learning.
pse.solution_function: The solution performs service index prediction by determining an initiator and partner data sets, encrypting the initiator data set, acquiring a ciphertext correlation coefficient matrix between initiator and partner, decrypting the ciphertext correlation coefficient matrix, determining correlation coefficient matrices for initiator and partner, performing multiple collinearity analysis on initiator and partner, determining model training data, and training a federal learning model.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of a data set determining module, a data set encryption transmission module, and a federal learning model.
pse.solution_implementation: The data set determining module determines the initiator and partner data sets. The data set encryption transmission module encrypts the initiator data set and sends it to the partner equipment. The partner device acquires a ciphertext correlation coefficient matrix, which is then decrypted by the initiator device. The plaintext correlation coefficient matrix is determined based on the decryption result. Correlation coefficient matrices for initiator and partner are calculated, multiple collinearity analysis is performed, model training data is determined, and a federal learning model is trained using the model training data.
pse.effect: The solution improves the calculation efficiency and precision of a linear model in longitudinal federated learning, resulting in improved prediction precision for user business indexes.
